description: Issued; waiting for the department's root cause analysis and action plan.
Response submitted; a QMS Admin is assessing the action plan.
Response returned to the department for rework, with a new reply due date.
Action plan accepted; the department is carrying out the corrective actions.
Implementation recorded; the countermeasure is verified a day after the target date.
Closed out; effectiveness is checked 6 months later or at the next internal audit.
Effective, kept under extended monitoring, or closed and re-issued. Overdue is a flag on any stage, not a status.
